Major grammar and clarity issues are present in the Narrative document:

- Duplicate text: The RYZE contact information is listed twice consecutively at the very beginning.
- Extraneous text in address: “Location: 536 E Portland Ave NA Fresno, CA 93720” contains an unnecessary “NA” inserted into the street line.
- Date formatting error: In ORIGIN OF LOSS, the date appears as “4-13- 26” with an extra space splitting the year.
- Missing preposition: “This laminate floor is continuous the piano room, living room, kitchen and dining room/nook.” The phrase needs a preposition (e.g., “continuous through the piano room, living room, kitchen, and dining room/nook”).
- Missing verb: “Cause of this loss a slab leak; wear and tear to the pipe in the slab with ensuing water damage.” The sentence is missing “is” after “Cause of this loss.”
- Nonstandard/incorrect notation: “No subrogation the plumbing is 20++ yrs old.” The “20++” construction is incorrect; use “over 20 years old” or “20+ years old.”
- Improper noun use: “Estimate completed with a possible reopen, should mitigation remove more than what is itemized...” The noun form should be “reopening,” or rephrase to “may reopen.”
- Template instruction left in body: “Explanation: (If you choose No, please provide reason(s) of why home is not habitable during the repair process)” remains in the document and is not completed; it also reads awkwardly (“reason(s) of why home” should be “reasons why the home…”).

Given these issues, the narrative does not meet the standard for major grammar/spelling correctness.
